lines.label: viscoelastic joints (passive)
lines.note: always on; stiffness and damping per joint

lines.label: proprioceptive sensing
lines.note: timescale = sensory delay (s); ignites when a joint velocity exceeds the threshold (rad/s)

lines.label: vestibular / head-motion sensing
lines.note: timescale = delay; ignites on trunk tilt rate (rad/s)

lines.label: visual feedback
lines.note: timescale = delay; ignites on a visible COM offset (m); can be blocked

lines.label: tactile / contact-pressure sensing
lines.note: timescale = delay; ignites on a centre-of-pressure shift (m)

lines.label: cue perception
lines.note: timescale = delay; the movement / direction-change cues are sensed through it

lines.label: local joint reflex
lines.note: timescale = loop latency; ignites on a fast sensed joint motion

lines.label: central balance command (ankle)
lines.note: timescale = latency; ignites on a sensed COM offset from the reference

lines.label: central balance command (hip)
lines.note: timescale = latency; ignites on a large COM offset

lines.label: central movement command (feed-forward)
lines.note: timescale = latency; ignites on a sensed cue

lines.label: tonic co-contraction (core)
lines.note: baseline co-contraction level; costs energy while on

lines.label: breathing cycle
lines.note: timescale = period (s); modulates trunk drive and chest motion

lines.label: energy supply / fatigue
lines.note: timescale = fatigue time constant (s); internal, no observation model sees it directly

lines.label: gain adaptation
lines.note: timescale = adaptation time constant (s); slow retained state

numerical_method: RK4 on the N-link planar Lagrangian equations with the muscle drive held over each step; batched seeds with common random numbers; first-order activation dynamics; digests over 6 significant digits

adaptation.definition: rate at which the peak deviation after a push falls over repeated trials (slope of log deviation)
adaptation.label: adaptation speed

consequence.definition: time from the stimulus until the consequence is established: the target reached, or a fall
consequence.label: time to the consequence

correction.definition: time from a push until the ankle torque deviates by more than 5 Nm against the push
correction.label: movement correction latency

movement_onset.definition: time from a cue until the COM has moved 3 mm towards the target
movement_onset.label: movement onset latency

muscle_onset.definition: time from a cue until the ankle net activation deviates from its baseline by more than 0.03
muscle_onset.label: muscle activation onset latency

neural_response.definition: time from a cue to the first ignition of the central movement command line
neural_response.label: neural response latency

reconfiguration.definition: rounds and simulated set-up time needed until an unobserved difference becomes identified (Experiment E)
reconfiguration.label: observation reconfiguration speed

recovery.definition: time after a push (from the largest deviation) until the COM is back within the pre-registered tolerance band of the reference and slow, for 0.4 s, inside the window that ends at the next protocol event
recovery.label: recovery time

sensory_detection.definition: time from a cue to the first ignition of the cue-perception line
sensory_detection.label: sensory detection latency

settling.definition: time after the direction change until the COM stays within the pre-registered tolerance band of the new target for 0.4 s
settling.label: settling time

results.reading: 'lapsed' is split into line-stopped, observation-lost and description-inapplicable; they are different findings.
